press_references.value: Fireblocks Expands GCC Stablecoin Payment Access Through ARP Digital Partnership

partnership_announcements.description: Fireblocks and ARP Digital have formed a new payments partnership in which ARP Digital integrates into the Fireblocks Network as its designated GCC corridor settlement partner, giving network participants regulated on/off-ramp and stablecoin settlement access across GCC currencies.

press_references.value: Fireblocks integrates Canton Network for regulated onchain settlement

partnership_announcements.description: Fireblocks integrated support for the Canton Network, enabling financial institutions to custody and settle Canton Coin and other regulated onchain assets through its platform.

press_references.value: Fireblocks and Zepz Join Forces to Scale Stablecoin Remittance Adoption for WorldRemit and Sendwave

partnership_announcements.description: Fireblocks and Zepz announced a new partnership in which Zepz, via its WorldRemit and Sendwave brands, will use Fireblocks' digital asset treasury and settlement infrastructure to power stablecoin-based remittance services.

press_references.value: Fireblocks Integrates XION To Bring Walletless Blockchain Access To 2,000+ Institutions

partnership_announcements.description: Fireblocks announced an integration partnership with XION to bring XION’s walletless, gasless Layer-1 blockchain into Fireblocks’ custody and settlement platform for institutional clients.

press_references.value: Fireblocks to use Smart Router from Lava Networks

partnership_announcements.description: Fireblocks announced it will integrate Lava Networks' Smart Router to enhance Web3 connectivity and routing, signaling a new technology partnership between the firms.

press_references.value: Fireblocks and Circle Strategically Collaborate to Accelerate Stablecoin Adoption for Financial Institutions

partnership_announcements.description: Fireblocks announced a strategic collaboration with Circle Internet Group to integrate Circle’s stablecoin network with Fireblocks’ custody, tokenization, and payments infrastructure, enabling institutions to build stablecoin-based payments, treasury, and settlement solutions.

press_references.value: Fireblocks Joins Project Acacia to Explore the Role of Digital Money in Wholesale Tokenised Asset Markets

partnership_announcements.description: Fireblocks announced its participation in Project Acacia, collaborating with NotCentralised, Redbelly Network, Australian Bond Exchange, and Fasanara Capital to pilot atomic settlement of tokenised securities using digital money in Australia.

overview_description.description:
Fireblocks is a platform that protects digital assets in transit, focusing on protecting the transmission of customers' digital assets between exchanges, counter brokers, hot wallets, and cold stores.

Fireblocks enables banks, fintech, exchanges, liquidity providers, OTCs, and hedge funds to securely manage digital assets across a wide range of products and services. The technology consists of the Fireblocks Network and MPC-based Wallet Infrastructure.

about_short_description.short_description: Fireblocks is a blockchain security service provider for moving, storing, and issuing digital assets.

product.name: Fireblocks Digital Asset Infrastructure Platform
product.description: An infrastructure platform for building, securing, managing, and automating digital asset operations, including wallets, transfers, issuance, governance, and blockchain connectivity.

product.name: Fireblocks Wallets and Custody
product.description: Wallet infrastructure for creating, securing, connecting, and managing digital asset wallets, including institutional custody and embedded wallet deployments.

product.name: Fireblocks Payments Infrastructure
product.description: Infrastructure for sending, receiving, accepting, and orchestrating stablecoin payments across blockchains, payment rails, currencies, and financial counterparties.

product.name: Fireblocks Network
product.description: A connectivity network linking digital asset businesses, financial institutions, liquidity providers, custodians, and payment participants for asset transfers and settlement.

product.name: Fireblocks Treasury Management
product.description: Tools for controlling, monitoring, and automating digital asset treasury operations across wallets, entities, blockchains, and counterparties.

product.name: Fireblocks Tokenization
product.description: Infrastructure for issuing and managing tokenized assets, including smart contract operations, lifecycle workflows, custody, and transfers.
